papers.abstract: Large-scale pretraining has made Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promising foundations for generalist robot manipulation, yet adapting them to downstream tasks remains necessary. However, the common practice of full fine-tuning treats pretraining as initialization and can shift broad priors toward narrow training-distribution patterns. We propose PriorVLA, a novel framework that preserves pretrained priors and learns to leverage them for effective adaptation. PriorVLA keeps a frozen Prior Expert as a read-only prior source and trains an Adaptation Expert for downstream specialization. Expert Queries capture scene priors from the pretrained VLM and motor priors from the Prior Expert, integrating both into the Adaptation Expert to guide adaptation. Together, PriorVLA updates only 25% of the parameters updated by full fine-tuning. Across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world tasks, PriorVLA achieves stronger overall performance than full fine-tuning and state-of-the-art VLA baselines, with the largest gains under out-of-distribution (OOD) and few-shot settings. PriorVLA improves over pi0.5 by 11 points on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard and achieves 99.1% average success on LIBERO. Across eight real-world tasks and two embodiments, PriorVLA reaches 81% in-distribution (ID) and 57% OOD success with standard data. With only 10 demonstrations per task, PriorVLA reaches 48% ID and 32% OOD success, surpassing pi0.5 by 24 and 22 points, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 和真实世界任务上，PriorVLA 超越全微调和最先进 VLA 基线；在 RoboTwin 2.0-Hard 上比 pi0.5 提高 11 个百分点；在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达到 99.1%；在 8 个真实世界任务和两种执行器上，标准数据下 ID 成功率 81%、OOD 成功率 57%；每任务仅 10 个演示时，ID 成功率 48%、OOD 成功率 32%，分别比 pi0.5 高 24 和 22 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PriorVLA 框架，冻结先验专家作为只读先验源，训练适配专家用于下游专业化，通过专家查询将场景先验与动作先验整合到适配专家中，实现参数高效的先验保留适配。
analysis.method: 冻结先验专家，训练适配专家；专家查询从预训练 VLM 和先验专家中提取场景先验与动作先验，并整合到适配专家中以引导适配；仅更新全微调 25% 的参数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PriorVLA 提出一种新的 VLA 适配框架，通过保留预训练先验并学习利用这些先验，仅更新全微调 25% 参数即可在下游任务上超越全微调和现有最优方法。

papers.abstract: Personalizing a text-to-image diffusion model by full fine-tuning gives the strongest subject fidelity but produces a full copy of the model per subject: a thousand personalized Stable Diffusion checkpoints approach five terabytes, so storage, not compute, is what fails to scale. We present Delta-SVD, which compresses the weight change that personalization makes rather than the model. Given only a finished checkpoint and its base, it takes a truncated SVD of each layer's weight delta and keeps the few components that carry its spectral energy, selected by a per-layer energy threshold or by a global byte budget filled by water-filling, optimal for the continuous relaxation and empirically near-optimal for discrete rank allocation. Nothing is trained and no subject image is read, so the method applies to legacy and third-party checkpoints for which training-time adapters such as LoRA were never produced. The factors merge back into dense weights at load time, so serving runs at the uncompressed model's exact latency, whereas whole-model 8-bit and 4-bit quantization slow inference by 1.5-3.4 times. On the 30-subject DreamBooth benchmark, Delta-SVD matches the uncompressed model to within 0.01 DINO at 7-fold compression and keeps 98% of its fidelity at 33-fold compression. Among post-hoc baselines, only dense-delta quantization at 411 MiB matches it; below that size Delta-SVD dominates pruning, random-rank selection, and both whole-model and dense-delta quantization on the storage-quality frontier. The same holds on 84 diverse CustomConcept101 subjects, where a 9 MiB adapter reproduces the uncompressed outputs at paired DINO 0.77, and on a fully fine-tuned SD3.5-medium MMDiT, where a 531 MB adapter matches the uncompressed model to within 0.01 DINO.

analysis.key_results: 在30主体DreamBooth基准上，7倍压缩时与未压缩模型DINO差距在0.01以内，33倍压缩时保持98%保真度；在84主体CustomConcept101和SD3.5-medium上同样表现优异。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Delta-SVD方法，对个性化模型与基座模型之间的权重差进行截断奇异值分解，并按层能量阈值或全局字节预算（water-filling）分配秩，实现存储压缩且推理延迟不变。
analysis.method: 对已完成微调的个性化模型与基座模型逐层权重差进行截断SVD，保留主要奇异值分量；秩分配采用逐层能量阈值或全局字节预算下的注水算法，加载时合并回稠密权重。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Delta-SVD，通过截断SVD压缩个性化扩散模型相对基座模型的权重增量，在不训练、不读取图像的情况下实现存储高效且推理零开销的压缩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型的权重增量压缩，与VLA或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但所提Delta-SVD作为独立后处理压缩技术，在原理上可迁移用于压缩机器人策略或世界模型的权重增量，具有潜在方法学价值。
